svg.text: Taxonomy / time / state arbor: claim trunk → article twig → SURFACE/BODY fork → Clock-A node → Clock-B node. No press-to-press lineage.
Article hue = frozen corpus stratum. Trunk temperature = post-incident public-record time; state remains shape/fill.
Clock states: faithful / drift / borderline / novel reporting (Clock A only)

Evidence phases are visual guides only. Claim trunks and true-date points encode temperature across the visible post-incident window from the 07-16 victim disclosure (hot → cold), redundant with x-position. Article hue encodes corpus stratum. Proposition ticks are explicitly dated ledger transitions. No line connects one press article to another.
